_comment: What a candidate explanation is allowed to say. The same idea as question_bank.json, applied to the other half of the exchange: a question is stable by id, and an answer is only countable if the words it can be given are a fixed set. Measured 2026-10-13: given this list the model answered '鼓点变密' and stayed inside it; given no list it echoed the facts it was sent, and once answered the same fact three times in three phrasings. Anything outside the list cannot be said, which is the price - 其他 and 都不是 are here so that it can still say so.
